goal: Verified payment refund/chargeback state'ini invoice refund review persistence akışına server-side bağlamak
rollback: Bu paketin payment-to-invoice reconciliation wiring ve testini geri al; payment, invoice, document veya delivery verisini silme veya resetleme
acceptance: Only an already verified payment state can request invoice refund review
Payment, invoice and workspace identifiers are server-derived and scope-bound
Refund/chargeback handoff is idempotent and never deletes invoice/document or issues credit note automatically
Unknown, contradictory or non-refund payment states fail closed
